name: Stalker (Vampire Hunter Archetype)
body:
Vampires are not the only prey that a sacred hunter would chase. A more versatile and inquisitorial version of the class, the stalker selects one enemy and follows its tracks methodically, urged by a divine mandate as much as personal hate.

Dedicated Foe (Ex)

At 1st level, a stalker selects a favored enemy from the ranger’s list. At 6th, 12th, and 18th level, his bonuses against the chosen enemy increase. He doesn’t gain more favored enemies at these levels.

This replaces technique feats.

Detect Enemy (Sp)

At 1st level, the stalker can feel the presence of his favored enemy at will. This functions as detect animals or plants, except it detects creatures of the selected type or subtype.

This alters detect undead.

Inquisitorial Office (Su)

A stalker gains an inquisitorial office at 1st level, chosen among the following: condemnation, confessors, judgment, pardons, or trials. He has the 1st-level abilities from this office as an inquisitor of his same level, gaining normally other uses with level advancing. At 8th, 16th, 17th, and 20th level, the stalker gains higher abilities from his selected office.

This replaces vampiric focus, stake, vampire tracker, vampire bane, remove vampirism, critical reflexes, and master vampire hunter.
